title: The fixed rule on neto1 v1 and on net1 v7, validation links: the u grid over three campaign seeds
description: neto1 v1 is expliCCit's encoder (one value per LCF) trained on net1 v6's data regenerated with the fixed guest (release exp-net1-point-228, the run named in chosen.txt). net1 v7 is net1 v6's recipe (64 bins, 3 members) retrained on the same data (release exp-net1v6-229, chosen.txt). The fixed rule's u is chosen on each net1 as in rule-net1v6-val.json: u in -0.25, 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5 (arms pt-u* on neto1 v1, v7-u* on net1 v7), with BBRv3 beside them, on the 21 validation links and five families, for campaign seeds 11, 21 and 31; the winner per net1 is the u with the highest mean over the five families on every seed, or, where seeds disagree or the gap is inside the noise, the one ahead on the mean over seeds. Validation links only.
prepare: U="-0.25 0 0.125 0.25 0.375 0.5"; P=(); for a in pt:n v7:m; do k=${a%:*} i=${a#*:}; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/$k" "$IN/$i/$(cat "$IN/$i/chosen.txt")/net1.pt" --u $U; for u in $U; do P+=(--policy "$k-u$u=$OUT/$k/rule-u$u.onnx"); done; done; for s in 11 21 31; do mkdir -p "$OUT/s$s"; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT/s$s" val $s $s bbr3 "${P[@]}"; done
run: for c in "$OUT"/s*/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: for s in 11 21 31; do uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT/s$s" --select pt v7; done; { for s in 11 21 31; do echo "# Campaign seed $s"; cat "$OUT/s$s/summary.md"; echo; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
